LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.0.label: Firm Footing
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.0.description: Retains the chosen Giant evolution. Refinement: burst damage or stationary shield strength. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50; shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.1.label: Breach the Line
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.1.description: Three ordinary hits against enemies within 2 cells, accumulated within 4 seconds, add 50 damage to the third victim. Cooldown: 3 seconds. Distant hits and bonus damage do not count; weapon type and racial body size are unrestricted. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.2.label: Brace
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.2.description: An ordinary hit against an enemy within 2 cells grants you a 50-point shield for 3 seconds. Cooldown: 4 seconds. This layer does not stack with itself, bonus damage cannot trigger it, and racial body size is unrestricted. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.3.label: Press the Advance
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.3.description: A real Breach the Line bonus leaves a 4-second pressure mark, keeping at most two. Your Earthshatter hit consumes it for 75 extra damage, at most once per second on each victim. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.4.label: Shoulder Through
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.4.description: A real Breach the Line bonus hits one other enemy within 2 cells for 50 damage. Cooldown: 3 seconds; no secondary target means no cooldown is spent. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.5.label: Answer the Blow
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.5.description: After your Brace layer absorbs enemy damage, remember the latest attacker for 3 seconds. Your next ordinary hit on that enemy within 2 cells returns the absorbed amount as damage, up to 2. One payment; absorbed hits do not accumulate. Refinement: retaliation cap. Actual absorption is not multiplied. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.6.label: Shoulder to Shoulder
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.6.description: Casting Earthshatter grants 50-point shields for 3 seconds to up to two other colonists within 3 cells, with a 6-second cooldown. No ally means no shield; Earthshatter cooldown is unchanged. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.7.label: Open Seam
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.7.description: Earthshatter spending a pressure mark leaves a 3-second seam on that victim, up to two. Your next ordinary hit within 2 cells spends the seam for 75 extra damage without creating pressure. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.8.label: Fault Line
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.8.description: A real Shoulder Through splash records both impact cells for 4 seconds. Walk to a position at least 2 cells from their connecting segment, then spend the fault with an ordinary hit within 2 cells. Each endpoint deals 50 damage to at most one enemy within 1.5 cells. No victim is hit twice; empty ground still spends the fault. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.9.label: Hold Formation
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.9.description: Complete two Answer the Blow returns against different attackers within 8 seconds to hold formation for 4 seconds. Your next Earthshatter cast spends it for a 3-point, 4-second personal shield. Repeating one attacker does not prepare it. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 75. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.10.label: Close Ranks
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.10.description: After Shoulder to Shoulder absorbs enemy damage, remember the first protected ally for 4 seconds. Walk within 2 cells of them and land an ordinary hit to heal up to 40 non-permanent injury, once per cast. No treatable injury preserves the opportunity; repeated absorption never extends its deadline. A new cast replaces the previous opportunity. Refinement: healing and shield strength. Base rewards: healing 40. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.11.label: Pin the Shot
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.11.description: Spending a seam delays its victim’s current ordinary weapon warmup by 0.5 seconds, if eligible. Airborne projectiles and special boss timers are unchanged; once per seam. Refinement: weapon warmup delay. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: control duration ×1.75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.12.label: Seize the Opening
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.12.description: After a seam deals real damage, heal up to 20 non-permanent injury on yourself. Actual healing records your position for 3 seconds. Walk at least 2 cells and finish at least 2 cells from that position, then hit an enemy within 2 cells for one more heal of up to 20. No treatable injury preserves the opportunity without extending its deadline. Refinement: healing. Base rewards: healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.13.label: Converging Faults
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.13.description: When both ends of one fault deal damage to different enemies, hold Converging Faults for 3 seconds. Your next Earthshatter hit spends it for 50 damage to up to two enemies within 1.5 cells of the impact cell. Only one charge is held, without stacking or renewal; different faults cannot complete a pair. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.14.label: Cover the Ground
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.14.description: After a fault deals real damage, grant 50-point shields for 3 seconds to up to two allied colonists within 2 cells of its original midpoint. The area follows neither caster nor victims; once per fault. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.15.label: Returning Weight
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.15.description: After a Hold Formation shield absorbs enemy damage, hold a return for 3 seconds. A close ordinary hit against its latest attacker spends it for 50 extra damage and reduces remaining Earthshatter cooldown by 1 second. Once per formation shield; later blocks update the attacker without extending the window. Refinement: bonus damage. Base rewards: damage 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: damage ×50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.16.label: Share the Wall
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.16.description: When Earthshatter spends Hold Formation, replace its 3-point shield with separate 50-point shields on you and the nearest other colonist within 3 cells, lasting 4 seconds. Without an ally, keep the original 3-point shield. Existing shield remainder is never copied. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.17.label: Turn the Line
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.17.description: After Close Ranks heals an ally, remember their position for 3 seconds. Walk outside that position’s 2-cell radius and land a close ordinary hit on a different enemy to grant that ally a 50-point shield for 3 seconds. No ally interaction is needed. Refinement: shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: shield ×20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.18.label: Stand Together
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Path_Titan.nodes.18.description: If an ally healed by Close Ranks remains below 50% total health, grant them a 50-point shield for 3 seconds. After it absorbs enemy damage, your next close ordinary hit may heal that ally for up to 20 non-permanent injury, once within 3 seconds. Refinement: healing and shield strength. Base rewards: shield 50; healing 20. Refinement starts at ×1; limits: healing ×10; shield ×20.
